ReplayVerification.Meaning: Compared available recorded checkpoints through the consumed prefix. This samples selected state and render data, not every hidden game field.

Meaning: Experimental owned bundle only. Per-view paired discovery calls alternate order; mapped flags are cleared before each call, freshly discovered bitsets compared, then unioned with prior flags. Optional reference also checks every cumulative hash. Cache clears on every call and keys actual vertex references; no cross-tic reuse. Timing includes cold calls and cache clear, excludes setup/flag reset/hash. Both paths include the experimental selection branch. Not loaded-host or display FPS.
